source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of bar charts (PDF 146).

blocks.text: Bar charts qismon ka muwazna karte hain: har bar ek qism aur us ki unchai ya lambai qeemat dikhati hai. Store mukhtalif products ki sales, ya do dinon mein unhi products ki sales, grouped bars se mila sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Bar chart jis ka unwan Sales on Day 1 and Day 2 for various items hai. Amudi mehwar, Number of products sold, 1000 tak. Chaar jore bars (Day 1 neela, Day 2 peela): 800 aur 600; 800 aur 1000; 1000 aur 600; 400 aur 600.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Mukhtalif products ki sales dikhane wala bar chart (kitab ki Figure 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Day 1 aur Day 2 ki sales ke liye grouped bars kyun mufeed hain?
blocks.explanation: Har product ki do bars saath saath hoti hain, to har product ke liye dinon ka farq aasani se nazar aata hai.

items: Bar chart: qismon mein qeematon ka muwazna.
